panel.title: Your store panel
panel.welcome: Manage your products, your calendar and your store settings here.

home.products: Create and edit products, prices, variants and stock.
home.calendar: Teams, opening hours and closed days for bookable products.
home.settings: Shipping, bank transfer payments, date surcharges and time zone.
home.orders: Review payments, set shipping fees and prices, confirm or cancel orders.
home.appearance: Colors, font, logo and welcome texts of your store.

products.title: Products
products.stockHint: Stock is the units available now; units held by orders are already taken off.
products.deleteHint: A product with orders or bookings cannot be deleted; deactivate it instead.
products.deleteConfirm: Delete this product? This cannot be undone.

editor.kindHint: Simple: fixed price. Configurable: the customer picks people and options and the price comes from the ranges.
editor.reservable: Booked for a date and time
editor.reservableHint: The customer picks a free time from your calendar.
editor.activeHint: Inactive products are hidden from the store.
editor.fixedPriceHint: Optional. Left empty, it is worked out with the exchange rate. Amount in {currency}.
editor.tiersHint: Each range sets the price per person and how many meats and toppings it includes. Ranges must follow each other with no gaps (1-10, 11-30...).
editor.meatsHint: Options the customer can pick. The extra price is charged for each one beyond those included.
editor.toppingsHint: Options the customer can pick. The extra price is charged for each one beyond those included.
editor.variantsHint: Optional: sizes, flavors or presentations. With variants, the customer must pick one.
editor.stockCurrent: Available stock: {stock}. Change it in the Stock section.
editor.trackStockHint: If unchecked, the variant never sells out. Can only be chosen when it is created.
editor.bookingHint: How long each booking takes and its limits. Opening hours are set in Calendar.
editor.bufferHint: Free time before the same team's next booking.
editor.maxDaysAhead: Book at most this many days ahead

settings.title: Store settings
settings.shippingModeHint: Shipping amounts are in the store's base currency.

modes.approval: I quote it on each order

settings.fixedFeeHint: Only for the flat fee mode. In {currency}, for example 80.00.
settings.prepay: Shipping is paid with the deposit
settings.prepayHint: Otherwise it is paid on delivery.
settings.holdHours: Hours to pay before the order is released
settings.holdHoursHint: From 1 to 168. After that time without payment, stock and time slots are freed.
settings.perLineDate: Each cart item has its own date
settings.perLineDateHint: Otherwise the whole order uses one date.
settings.instructionsHint: Bank, account number and account holder. Shown to the customer when the order is placed.
settings.rulesHint: An amount or percent added on some weekdays or dates.
settings.ruleValueHint: Fixed amount in {currency} (for example 50.00) or percent (for example 10).
settings.ruleDatesHint: Format YYYY-MM-DD, one per line or separated by commas.
settings.zonesHint: Used by the by-zone shipping mode.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.intro: Set who serves, when, and which days you are closed. Only bookable products use this.
calendar.productsEmpty: No product has bookings turned on.
calendar.productLimits: {service} min per booking, start times every {step} min
calendar.productNoLimits: Booking times missing: edit the product.
calendar.resourcesHint: Each team takes one booking at a time. Without teams, the store works as a single team.
calendar.resourceActiveHint: Deactivate it instead of deleting it once it has bookings.
calendar.servicesHint: If none is checked, it serves all of them.
calendar.hoursHint: A team with its own hours uses only those; the others use the whole store's hours.
calendar.hoursEmpty: Without opening hours the store offers no bookings.
calendar.closedHint: Days without bookings, for the whole store or one team.

orders.title: Orders
orders.overdueSummary: {count, plural, one {# order has} other {# orders have}} been awaiting your review for more than {hours} hours.
orders.overdue: Awaiting your review for more than {hours} hours
orders.limitNote: Showing the {limit} most recent orders. Use the filters to see others.
orders.deadline: The customer has until {when} to pay.
orders.pendingQuoteLine: More people than the last tier: you set the price.
orders.prepayNote: Shipping is charged in the deposit.
orders.noProofs: The customer has not uploaded any proof.
orders.proofLinkHint: The link lasts 5 minutes. If it expired, reload the page.
orders.proofUnavailable: The proof could not be loaded. Reload the page in a moment.
orders.noActions: This order can no longer be changed.
orders.amountHint: In {currency}, with a decimal point (for example 150.00). The total and deposit are recalculated.
orders.amountHintConverted: In {currency}, with a decimal point (for example 150.00). It is converted to {orderCurrency} at the order rate; the total and deposit are recalculated.
orders.priceIntro: The order has more people than your last tier. Type the price of that part.
orders.approveIntro: Check that the payment reached your account before approving.
orders.confirmIntro: This order is paid on delivery. Confirm it to keep the product and the time slot.
orders.approveConfirm: Do you confirm you received the payment? The order will be confirmed.
orders.rejectIntro: The order goes back to awaiting payment and the customer can upload another proof.
orders.rejectReasonHint: The customer will see it. For example: the amount does not match.
orders.cancelIntro: The held product and time slot become available again.
orders.cancelConfirmedWarning: This order is already confirmed. Cancelling it returns the product to stock and frees the time slot. Do not cancel it if you already delivered it.
orders.cancelConfirm: Cancel this order? The product and the time slot become available again.
orders.cancelConfirmedConfirm: Cancel this confirmed order? The product returns to stock and the time slot is freed. Do not do it if you already delivered it.
orders.cancelReasonHint: It is kept in the order history.

appearance.title: Store appearance
appearance.intro: Choose the colors, font, logo and texts your customers see. Before saving we check that texts are readable.
appearance.colorsHint: Text must contrast at least 4.5 to 1 with the background; the main and accent colors at least 3 to 1.

colorHint.primary: Button background. The button label is picked automatically (white or black) so it stays readable.
colorHint.accent: Links, highlighted borders and the keyboard focus ring.

appearance.textHint: Optional, up to {max} characters. If one language is missing the other is shown; if both are, the store name is shown.
appearance.logoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP up to 1 MB. Shown in the store header instead of the name.
appearance.noLogo: No logo yet: the store shows its name.
appearance.previewLink: This is how a link looks

errors.slugTaken: That address is already in use.
errors.slugInvalid: Use 3 to 40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, with no leading or trailing hyphen.
errors.currencyDuplicate: Repeated currency or same as the base.
errors.rateInvalid: Enter an exchange rate greater than 0.
errors.notPending: This store was already set up.

invite.title: Invite the owner
invite.help: We will email them a link to create their password and enter their store panel.

errors.alreadyMember: That email already belongs to another store or to the agency.
errors.existingAccount: That email already has an account with no store. Check it with the technical team.
errors.tenantNotActive: Finish setting up the store first; only the owner of an active store can be invited.
errors.failed: The invitation could not be sent. Please try again.

errors.moneyFormat: Enter an amount with digits and a decimal point, with no more decimals than the currency uses (for example 180.00).
errors.count: Use a whole number from 0 to 1000.
errors.idRequired: Enter a name (64 characters at most).
errors.tierRange: Use whole numbers from 1, with "from" not above "to".
errors.tiersRequired: Add at least one people range.
errors.tiersGap: There is a gap between ranges: each one must start right after the previous one.
errors.stock: Use a whole number of 0 or more.
errors.simpleWithConfigurable: A simple product has no people ranges.
errors.configurableRequired: A configurable product needs people ranges.
errors.ruleValue: Use a value of 0 or more.
errors.ruleMatchesNothing: Pick at least one weekday or one date.
errors.holdHours: Use a whole number of hours from 1 to 168.
errors.timezone: That time zone does not exist. Example: America/Tegucigalpa.
errors.resourceName: Enter a name (80 characters at most).
errors.hoursOrder: Closing time must be after opening time.
errors.dailyLimit: Use a whole number from 1 to 1000, or leave it empty.
errors.inUse: It cannot be deleted because orders or bookings use it. Deactivate it instead.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to change this.
errors.insufficientStock: There is not enough stock to remove that quantity.
errors.notTracked: This variant does not track stock.
errors.stockValue: Use a whole number (not negative when setting the quantity).
errors.failed: Could not save. Please try again.
errors.holdsReleased: It cannot be confirmed: the payment deadline passed and the product or time slot was already released. If the customer paid late, create the order again or refund them.
errors.noProof: There is no proof to review.
errors.orderState: The order changed while you were viewing it. Reload the page.
errors.themeFont: Choose one of the fonts in the list.
errors.themeText: Keep within the length shown, on one line and without the < or > signs.
errors.contrastText: The text is hard to read on the background: contrast must be at least 4.5 to 1. Darken the text or lighten the background (or the other way round).
errors.contrastPrimary: The main color blends into the background: contrast must be at least 3 to 1.
errors.contrastAccent: The accent color blends into the background: contrast must be at least 3 to 1.
errors.logoPath: The saved logo is not valid. Upload the logo again.
errors.logoType: The logo must be a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
errors.logoSize: The logo is larger than 1 MB. Use a lighter image.
